scope: read-only training-cache sample-index audit; no model construction or market training
method: Group every cached training sample by (sample_day, sample_stock); count sample_clock bit masks and finite targets. Read mmap index/target arrays only; no feature arrays loaded, shared files unchanged.
limitations: Training split only; validation, test and platform request grouping still require separate audit.
Eight input occurrences do not imply eightfold wall-time speedup.
Grouped training changes sample correlation and shared dropout; it is a new training design, not numerical equivalence to sample shuffle.
